features.availability: Every constituent close comes from an exact completed 8-hour bar at or before decision_time.
features.formula: log(close_t / close_(t-1)) minus same-bar cross-sectional median log return
features.lag: zero additional lag after each source bar closes
features.missing_rule: Omit an invalid symbol; flatten if fewer than 24 valid symbols remain.

features.availability: Uses the oldest 105 of 126 completed residual returns.
features.formula: sample standard deviation of the first 105 residual returns
features.missing_rule: Flatten on a non-finite or effectively zero baseline.

features.availability: All horizon endpoints are closed by decision_time.
features.formula: sum of latest h residual returns divided by baseline volatility times sqrt(h), then tanh(z/3), for h in 21,63,126

features.availability: Built after all three horizon components are frozen.
features.formula: median sets direction; require two agreeing horizons; weighted 0.50/0.30/0.20 core times agreeing-weight squared
features.missing_rule: Set raw signal to zero if fewer than two horizons agree or weighted core conflicts with consensus.

features.availability: Recent and baseline volatility windows are both complete.
features.formula: multiply by min(1, baseline 105-bar volatility / recent 21-bar volatility)
features.missing_rule: Never boost a low-volatility signal; flatten on invalid scale.

features.availability: Built only after residualization, all horizon transforms, agreement, and volatility shrinkage.
features.formula: deterministic magnitude rank within persistence sign with inactive raw-zero names fixed at exact zero
features.missing_rule: Capture one empty built-in dictionary on a scheduled construction failure.

raw_fields.missing_rule: Exactly one finite positive close at each of 127 exact opens; no fill.

raw_fields.coverage: Pure-crypto point-in-time membership intersected with executability
raw_fields.missing_rule: Reject duplicates and require at least 24 valid symbols.
